derivation.formula: Ported from the legacy calculator so the consumers trained on those values keep reading the same series. MA and VMA over 5/10/20/60/120/240 trading days of raw official close and volume; KD from a nine-day RSV smoothed twice at alpha 1/3, with a flat window treated as the neutral 50; RSI 6 and 12 as adjusted exponential means of gain and loss with com = window - 1; MACD as the 12/26 exponential difference with a 9-period signal; Bollinger bands at the 20-day mean plus and minus two sample standard deviations. A window containing an unpublished price yields nothing rather than closing the gap.
derivation.calendar_convention: Trading days of the stock's own daily-price history from one source, in order. The rolling as-of series computes observation date D at the instant D's own prices become public under exchange_daily_settled@1 (03:00 Asia/Taipei on D+1), which is why D's own close is part of D's value and D+1's is not.
derivation.price_adjustment_convention: raw_official_close: no corporate-action adjustment. Legacy computed these on raw prices and its consumers were trained that way; an adjusted variant is a later derivation version, not a silent change.
